dedupe_keys.name: sturm flood u net trained on sentinel 2 imagery

description: WEO publishes a pretrained U-Net for mapping flooded and non-flooded urban areas from Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery. The model accompanies STURM-Flood, a global event benchmark with 10 m, 128-by-128-pixel image tiles. Its concept DOI resolves to version 10.5281/zenodo.15189634. Zenodo provides a TAR.GZ model archive under CC-BY-4.0, with public, free access. The project’s Python and TensorFlow inference notebook writes water probabilities, binary masks and optional per-tile metrics; the notebook’s CC-BY-SA-4.0 licence is separate from the model archive licence. Optical cloud cover and differences between new scenes and the training sample create uncertainty when transferring the model to other events. The model could generate flood-extent observations to evaluate infrastructure inundation simulations. It complements the project’s radar-based model with an optical sensing route. Exact training-date coverage, archive contents and predictive accuracy were not independently checked, and no weights were downloaded.
